verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page says it can detect images in documents, and its extraction docs mention citations that point back to the exact spot on the page, so there is some page-level traceability. Nothing in the evidence shows figures or charts being described (VLM summaries) or returned as image crops with bounding boxes in parse output. missing for 10: documented figure/chart description or summarization, image crop output, per-figure bounding boxes or page coordinates in parse chunks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
